title: Invasion Game Commons
learning_focus: Modified invasion-game concepts, movement, space, teamwork, decision-making, and holistic wellness.
story_premise: The commons’ teams chase the ball without spacing, communication, or fair participation.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Modified invasion-game concepts, movement, space, teamwork, decision-making, and holistic wellness.
